Degree-normal variance D and the positive t solving 2(n-2)t²-(n-4)t-2=0 imply t²*m*D=T, giving all edge and vertex facet contacts at slacks a,b. Strictly positive weights alpha=T/m, beta=T/(2mt) obey both exact John balancing and identity-moment equations; uniqueness, spectrum and volume follow. Independent symbolic factorization checked t²mD−T and specialized broader spectral root are multiples of same quadratic, with finite sample n=3,4,5,7,10 as consistency checks.
